about: Checkpoints of the benchmark configurations. run.sh resolves a key to $FASTAFD_MODEL_ROOT/<dir> unless FASTAFD_MODEL_<KEY> (upper case, '-' and '.' -> '_') names the directory.

eagle3-qwen3-235b.note: same weights as the upstream revision; only config.json raises max_position_embeddings from 40960 to 262144 so the draft accepts 32K contexts (benchmark.py prepare-draft writes this copy with a symlinked model.safetensors)
